parsed.rationale: The subtask is to compile the obtained list of healthcare professionals into a formatted document for mailing. The Cartify - getAllUsers API can provide a list of users, which can be used as the healthcare_professionals_list input. It directly supports obtaining user lists, which is relevant to compiling the mailing list. Other APIs are unrelated or do not provide user list data.
